scope.frame: two-dimensional conformal field theory: the tricritical Ising minimal model M(5, 4)
scope.object: its fusion ring and twists, against the Ising and Fibonacci theories
scope.hypotheses: fusion and twists only (not the full modular tensor category data); the link to the weave (the Pauli point as the Ising layer, the rule's LP as the Fibonacci fusion matrix) is a reading

claim_one_line: THE TRICRITICAL ISING MODEL AS ISING TIMES FIBONACCI (P-226; a check of a reading, known mathematics): the fusion ring of M(5, 4) (c = 7/10), from its S-matrix by Verlinde's formula, equals Ising x Fibonacci under exactly one bijection of labels, and the twists agree mod 1 with exactly one product, Ising with nu = 7 times the conjugate Fibonacci (c = 7/2 - 14/5 = 7/10 mod 8); the N = 1 supercurrent (h = 3/2) is the Ising layer's fermion. Read with the record: the common point's qubit (Clifford) layer and the rule's golden (Fibonacci) layer multiply, at the level of fusion and twists, to the record's c = 7/10 thread; the golden chain of Fibonacci anyons is critical there. No number of the 19. 0 of 19.
weave_or_thread: thread (a reading connecting the weave's two discrete layers)
